ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; no driver-side abuse flag (driver never claimed "I'm Here"), but keep the case on file.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's claim of being en route is consistent with the GPS record but irrelevant: the fee fails the NS-4 3-minute test (cancellation at 2 min 30 s), and no NS-1 no-show conditions were ever recorded [F1][F3][F4].
Traffic/route facts bear on route-deviation reasonable cause (RD-4), not on a within-3-minute rider cancellation under NS-4.
